images.name: journey-stock
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one premium editorial photograph for a step-by-step pricing assistant for a fictional German online smartwatch retailer. Landscape 1536x1024. Warm charcoal and muted olive interior, copper sunlight, natural tactile materials, thoughtful independent shop, believable proportions, cinematic but authentic. No readable text, no logos, no watermark, no graphics or dashboards superimposed. It must work as a wide webpage photo crop. Stage ONE: organizing the business data. Overhead three-quarter still life of a wooden stockroom desk: three generic unbranded smartwatches on simple product trays, small cardboard stock boxes, a closed-order ledger with indistinct writing, a barcode scanner beside a laptop keyboard, retailer's hand moving one watch box into order. Capture practical inventory and getting organized. Keep main objects in central horizontal band. Rich warm shadow, fine texture, no charts.
